worldcombat.skill.sharpen.summary: Push the body's edges out to raise Attack; while the edges last, anyone who strikes you up close is cut by them.
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.use.0: Raise your edges before a brawl so foes think twice about closing in
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.use.1: When chased, add Attack and leave a cut on the pursuer
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.use.2: Refresh the edges in a safe opening to keep the window up
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.description.0: Push out the edges: Attack +%1$s stage(s); while the window lasts, a foe who touches you takes about %2$s edge damage (physical).
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.description.1: The edge window lasts about %1$s, snapping out about %2$s edges over a %3$s-block radius.
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.description.2: Telegraph %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.quick.on: Quick edges: telegraph -2 ticks and cooldown -15 for frequent refresh; the window is x0.75, edge power x0.9 and fewer spikes.
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.quick.off: Solid edges: telegraph and cooldown as written, for a longer window and a heavier counter.
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.timing: The telegraph can be interrupted without paying anything; PP and cooldown settle only after commit.
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.growth.0: From level %1$s: edge window %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.growth.1: From level %1$s: edge window %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sharpen.preference.qui: On: telegraph -2 ticks and cooldown -15 for frequent refresh, but the window is x0.75, edge power x0.9 and fewer spikes. Off: slower and dearer, for a longer window and a heavier counter.
Consider sharpening when a threat is within this distance; larger raises the edges earlier.
Stop sharpening and fight when a threat is closer than this; larger gives it up more often up close.
On: prefer to raise the edges once a foe is within 4 blocks so the contact eats the counter. Off: raise them even at range for the Attack alone.
